name: Deutsches Studierendenwerk (DSW)
what: National association of all 57 Studierendenwerke. Represents them politically and publishes the yearly statistics this site uses for student numbers.

name: Arbeitsgemeinschaft Studierendenwerke NRW
what: Working group of the twelve Studierendenwerke in North Rhine-Westphalia. Publishes a joint yearly performance report.
